limitations: This fixture contains values stated in the published paper, not raw observations.
The Zenodo archive contents and DOI relationship have not yet been independently resolved.
Rounded rate pairs and source-reported percent changes are kept as separate claims because direct division does not reproduce every printed campaign percentage.
The D/Pd ratio during fusion was not directly measured in each fusion run; the paper relates it to separate in-situ XRD characterization.
This result is accelerator-driven D-D fusion and does not demonstrate cold fusion, excess-energy generation, or net energy.
limitation: The printed campaign saturation-rate uncertainties are 0.5, 0.5, and 1.3 n/s for Phase I, and 0.4, 0.5, and 1.3 n/s for Phase II. The earlier fixture transcription of the third Phase I uncertainty as 0.3 was corrected to 1.3 after checking the article PDF.
